title: Beyond Refusals: AQI as an Intrinsic Alignment Diagnostic via Latent Geometry, Cluster Divergence, and Layer wise Pooled Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the latent geometric separability (using the Alignment Quality Index, or AQI) of model activations between benign prompts and unsafe prompts designed to elicit racist hate speech, slurs, and ethnic stereotypes.

Evaluating the latent geometric separability (AQI) of model activations between benign prompts and unsafe prompts designed to elicit religious intolerance, mockery, and defamatory statements against various faiths and beliefs.

Evaluating the latent geometric separability (AQI) of model activations between benign prompts and unsafe prompts soliciting slurs, insults, and ridicule targeting individuals with physical disabilities, mental illness, or autism.
Evaluating the latent geometric separability (AQI) of model activations between benign prompts and unsafe prompts containing hateful screeds and bigotry directed at the LGBTQ+ community.

Evaluating the latent geometric separability (AQI) of model activations between benign prompts and unsafe prompts containing xenophobic hate speech, false claims, and demeaning messages directed at migrants and refugees.
